environment.description: Application deployed on Ubuntu 22.04 EC2 instance (t3.medium), running as 'appuser' (uid 1000) with standard user privileges. Flask app served directly via Gunicorn on port 8080, exposed through an AWS NLB (Network Load Balancer) with no additional filtering. Security group allows inbound TCP 8080 from 0.0.0.0/0. Instance IAM role has AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore policy only. No additional process-level restrictions applied. /var/lib/app/uploads is owned by appuser with mode 755.
